matches.description: Watch Paris Saint Germain vs Aston Villa highlights and goals from UEFA Super Cup on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 12, 2026. The CAF Super Cup final on August 12, 2026, delivered a captivating football spectacle as Paris Saint-Germain squared off against Aston Villa . With a trophy on the line, both sides displayed immense tactical discipline and offensive flair in front of a crowd of 27,681. PSG Strike Early Through Kvaratskhelia Paris Saint-Germain established their rhythm early, utilizing their 56% ball possession to stretch the Aston Villa defense. The breakthrough arrived in the 20th minute when Vitinha found Desire Doue , who expertly set up Khvicha Kvaratskhelia . The forward made no mistake, firing a right-footed shot into the net to give the French giants the lead. PSG continued to threaten, but Villa remained compact, waiting for their moment to strike back on the counter. Villa's Resilient Comeback As the first half drew to a close, Aston Villa found a second wind. Brian Madjo was agonizingly close to an equalizer in the 44th minute when his effort rattled the post. However, his persistence paid off just moments later. In the 45th minute, John McGinn delivered a pinpoint assist to Madjo , who unleashed a brilliant left-footed volley to level the score. The goal shifted the momentum, sending both teams into the break with everything to play for. VAR Drama and Defensive Resilience The second half saw the introduction of Ousmane Dembele , whose impact was immediate. In the 61st minute, a key sequence involving Achraf Hakimi and Dembele allowed Desire Doue to find the back of the net. The goal was initially subject to a VAR review, but the decision stood, much to the delight of the PSG faithful. In the final stages, Aston Villa pushed forward with desperation. Emiliano Buendia had a golden chance to equalize in stoppage time, but his header flashed wide of the target. PSG’s defense, bolstered by late substitutions like Lucas Beraldo , held firm under pressure to secure a 2-1 victory and claim the title.
